fmiModelDescription.description: Warehouse fulfillment cycle: an overhead pick-arm trolley slides to each individually sized shelf parcel, lifts it above the rack, returns to the AGV and hands it to the truck loader. The loader stows parcels from the deep cargo row toward the rear opening.

ScalarVariable.name: robotSpeed
ScalarVariable.description: AGV travel speed for outbound and return trips.

ScalarVariable.name: startStop
ScalarVariable.description: Start or pause warehouse operations.

ScalarVariable.name: jam
ScalarVariable.description: Inject a safety stop and raise the warehouse alarm.

ScalarVariable.name: rushOrder
ScalarVariable.description: Prioritize the next outbound AGV trip with a 45% higher speed setpoint.

ScalarVariable.name: agvPosition
ScalarVariable.description: Automated guided vehicle travel position, including alignment with the centered truck conveyor.

ScalarVariable.name: robotAngle
ScalarVariable.description: Gripper tilt while clamping a parcel.

ScalarVariable.name: packageOnAgv
ScalarVariable.description: A package is loaded on the AGV during its outbound trip.

ScalarVariable.name: alarm
ScalarVariable.description: Warehouse safety alarm.

ScalarVariable.name: ordersPicked
ScalarVariable.description: Number of orders fully loaded into a truck.

ScalarVariable.name: forkHeight
ScalarVariable.description: Carrier cart roller-deck lift height during parcel handoff.

ScalarVariable.name: inventoryLevel
ScalarVariable.description: Remaining inventory level as a percentage.

ScalarVariable.name: orderQuantity
ScalarVariable.description: Packages requested for this order. The truck can hold at most six packages.

ScalarVariable.name: truckLoadCount
ScalarVariable.description: Packages delivered and loaded into the outbound truck.

ScalarVariable.name: orderComplete
ScalarVariable.description: The requested packages have been loaded, or the truck has reached its six-package capacity.

ScalarVariable.name: sourcePackageVisible
ScalarVariable.description: The source carton remains visible on the rack before a pick begins.

ScalarVariable.name: pickupPackageVisible
ScalarVariable.description: A carton is being moved from the rack to the AGV.

ScalarVariable.name: transferPackageVisible
ScalarVariable.description: A carton is moving from the AGV along the loading conveyor and into the truck.

ScalarVariable.name: pickupProgress
ScalarVariable.description: Progress of the trolley, shelf pickup and AGV handoff cycle, from zero to one.

ScalarVariable.name: transferPackageX
ScalarVariable.description: Current horizontal position of the package being loaded into its truck cargo slot.

ScalarVariable.name: transferPackageY
ScalarVariable.description: Current height of the size-aware package on the conveyor and in the truck.

ScalarVariable.name: transferPackageZ
ScalarVariable.description: Current depth position of the package moving from the conveyor into its truck cargo slot.

ScalarVariable.name: loaderAngle
ScalarVariable.description: Loading robot arm angle while it places a package into the truck.

ScalarVariable.name: beltPhase
ScalarVariable.description: Roller rotation phase while a package is being transferred to the truck.

ScalarVariable.name: loaderReach
ScalarVariable.description: Truck loader arm extension to follow the package from the conveyor into each cargo slot.

ScalarVariable.name: shelfPackage1Visible
ScalarVariable.description: The first source parcel remains on its rack pallet until picked.

ScalarVariable.name: shelfPackage2Visible
ScalarVariable.description: The second source parcel remains on its rack pallet until picked.

ScalarVariable.name: shelfPackage3Visible
ScalarVariable.description: The third source parcel remains on its rack pallet until picked.

ScalarVariable.name: shelfPackage4Visible
ScalarVariable.description: The fourth source parcel remains on its rack pallet until picked.

ScalarVariable.name: shelfPackage5Visible
ScalarVariable.description: The fifth source parcel remains on its rack pallet until picked.

ScalarVariable.name: shelfPackage6Visible
ScalarVariable.description: The sixth source parcel remains on its rack pallet until picked.

ScalarVariable.name: packageSizeX
ScalarVariable.description: Width of the current parcel, shared by the pickup, AGV, conveyor and loader views.

ScalarVariable.name: packageSizeY
ScalarVariable.description: Height of the current parcel, shared by the pickup, AGV, conveyor and loader views.

ScalarVariable.name: packageSizeZ
ScalarVariable.description: Depth of the current parcel, shared by the pickup, AGV, conveyor and loader views.

ScalarVariable.name: pickupArmX
ScalarVariable.description: Current position of the pick-arm trolley along the shelf rail.

ScalarVariable.name: pickupArmY
ScalarVariable.description: Fixed vertical position of the overhead pick-arm rail.

ScalarVariable.name: pickupArmZ
ScalarVariable.description: Depth position of the overhead pick-arm rail above the shelf packages.

ScalarVariable.name: pickupArmAngle
ScalarVariable.description: Pick-arm trolley heading along its rail.

ScalarVariable.name: pickupArmReach
ScalarVariable.description: Full telescopic reach from the shelf line to the AGV handoff point.

ScalarVariable.name: pickupDropY
ScalarVariable.description: Vertical offset from the overhead rail to the selected shelf package center.

ScalarVariable.name: pickupArmReachProgress
ScalarVariable.description: Current telescopic arm extension from the shelf line toward the AGV.

ScalarVariable.name: pickupDropProgress
ScalarVariable.description: Current vertical offset of the gripper and parcel from the overhead trolley.

ScalarVariable.name: packageColorBlue
ScalarVariable.description: The current parcel uses the same blue material as its shelf source.

ScalarVariable.name: packageColorGold
ScalarVariable.description: The current parcel uses the same gold material as its shelf source.

ScalarVariable.name: packageColorCoral
ScalarVariable.description: The current parcel uses the same coral material as its shelf source.

ScalarVariable.name: pickupGripperGap
ScalarVariable.description: Distance between the gripper jaw centers while opening and closing around a parcel.
